But better approach: Use get_nearest_airport_by_city for Rivermist. That returns nearest airport code. Then use get_flight_cost with travel_from=that code, travel_to=JFK, travel_date="2026-12-01", travel_class="first".

Call get_nearest_airport_by_city({"location":"Rivermist"}). It will give us something like {"nearestAirportCode": "..."}.

Then call get_flight_cost with parameters accordingly.

We'll produce result.
